mapper.sql: u.user_id AS "userId",u.user_nm AS "name",u.email_addr AS "email",u.user_stat_cd AS "status", u.last_login_dttm AS "lastLoginAt",u.reg_user_id AS "regUserId",u.reg_dttm AS "regDttm",u.mod_user_id AS "modUserId",u.mod_dttm AS "modDttm"

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND ur.role_id=#{businessRole})

mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_sy_user u ORDER BY u.user_idu.email_addr u.user_stat_cdu.last_login_dttm u.user_nm DESCASC NULLS LAST,u.user_id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM tb_sy_user u WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT r.role_id AS "roleId",r.role_nm AS "name",r.use_yn AS "useYn" FROM tb_sy_user_role ur JOIN tb_sy_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY r.role_id
SELECT role_id AS "roleId",role_nm AS "name",use_yn AS "useYn" FROM tb_sy_role WHERE role_id IN ('PM','SALES_LDR') AND use_yn='Y' ORDER BY role_id
SELECT DISTINCT s.proj_id FROM tb_sy_user_scope s WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.scope_type_cd='PROJ' AND s.proj_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.proj_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_sy_user(user_id,user_nm,email_addr,pwd_hash,pwd_chg_dttm,temp_pwd_yn,pwd_err_cnt,user_stat_cd, last_login_dttm,mfa_use_yn,mfa_code_hash,mfa_expr_dttm,mfa_err_cnt,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) VALUES(#{input.userId},#{input.name},#{input.email},#{passwordHash},NULL,'Y',0,'USE',NULL,'N',NULL,NULL,0,#{actor},#{now}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_sy_user_role WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND role_id IN ('PM','SALES_LDR') AND role_id=#{roleId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.part_nm FROM tb_bs_part p JOIN tb_bs_part_std s ON s.part_id=p.part_id WHERE p.hq_yn='N' AND s.part_ldr_user_id=#{userId} AND (s.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR s.aply_end_ym >= #{month}) ORDER BY p.part_nm
